# tosijs-floorplan

> Render an agent-surface map — plain records describing a UI's wired
> elements — as a floorplan SVG wearing an explicit affordance grammar, so
> "can I act here?" never needs guessing. A pure function over plain data:
> no DOM, no framework, zero dependencies. Formerly `tosijs-schematic`
> (renamed at 0.3.0; the exported API keeps its schematic-* names).

Install: `npm add tosijs-floorplan`

## Core API (all exported from the package root)

- `schematic(description, options?)` → `{ svg, legend }` — the primary
  form. The legend carries what the drawing could not legibly hold
  (cramped/truncated/undersized records), keyed by index/ref. **Pair every
  raster with its legend** — the image says *where and which*; the legend
  says *what*.
- `schematicSVG(description, options?)` → `string` — just the svg; each
  `<g>` carries `data-record="<i>"` indexing back into
  `description.wiring[i]`.
- `rasterizeSVG(svg, {scale})` → PNG Blob for vision encoders (browser
  canvas; under bun/node use `@resvg/resvg-js`; rasterize at 2×).
- `boundsOf(element)` — an element's page-coordinate bounds (the natural
  `within` argument). The only browser-touching exports are these two;
  everything else runs anywhere JSON does.
- `BOUND_TO_DOM` (`⟵`, display binding) and `BOUND_TWO_WAY` (`⟷`,
  user-writable) — the provenance tokens found inside bound value strings
  (`"<shown> <arrow> <path>"`).

Options: `pad`, `minLabelHeight`, `maxCaption`, `fontSize`, `within`
(page-coordinate rect: spatial scoping — the viewBox IS the region),
`index: true` (stamp record indexes), `targetSize` (undersized-audit
floor: 24 default per WCAG 2.5.8, 44/48 for touch, 0 off),
`legendNote: false`, `decorate` (EXPERIMENTAL per-record plugin seam).

## The record format (multi-producer contract)

One flat record per wired element: `tag` (required), `bounds`
({x,y,width,height} — zero-size or absent = not drawn), `label`
(accessible name), `placeholder` (hint — never conflated with content),
`text`, `value`, `href`, `type`, `checked`, `focused`, `invalid`,
`required`, `disabled`, `contentEditable`, `on` (handlers by event type),
`list`, `structural`, `viewportFixed`, `style`, `ref` (durable actionable
handle), `flags` (computed verdicts, e.g. contrast), `image` (data-URL
media snapshot), `id`, `part`, `role`, `description`. Bound props ride as
`"value ⟷ path"` strings. Producers: tosijs `describe()` (reference),
haltija DOM extraction. The full field table and grammar legend live in
the README — it is the format specification. Field semantics changes
require producer sign-off; additive optional fields are fine.

## The affordance grammar (what the drawing means)

Bold outline = wired to act; `↔` badge = editable here; faded = disabled
(beats bold); double outline = keyboard focus; faint dotted = structure
and list containers (ground, not figure); italic caption = placeholder
hint; `*` = required; red corner flag = invalid now; `✕`/dot = live
toggle state drawn as geometry; left-edge bars = producer flags and the
target-size audit; top-right number/ref on white = the raster's index
into the wiring. Everything is geometry or ASCII — rare glyphs tofu
under rasterizers and never enter caption runs.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-floorplan/blob/main/README.md):
  quick start, the full record-format specification, grammar table, API.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-floorplan/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  release history (Keep a Changelog).

## Facts an agent should not have to rediscover

- Output stability is a promise: unchanged input → unchanged SVG across
  patch releases; consumers snapshot-test the output.
- tosijs vendors `src/index.ts` verbatim (hence `src/` ships in the npm
  tarball and the source stays one self-contained file).
- `tosijs-schema` is a different package (JSON-schema validation); the
  name similarity is acknowledged and deliberate history.
